title: Seven More Body Words, Spaced on Purpose
label: ch:ja-body-seven-more
canDo: I can read, write, hear, and say seven more body words while retrieving older script, greeting, farewell, and repair knowledge at expanding intervals.

payoff.summary: Seven fully decodable body labels interleaved with measured R3 and R4 retrieval rather than taught as a single topical list.
